error_note_zh: metadata 中 polity 字段被填为「金」——对于1633年莫卧儿印度细密画而言，「金」既不对应任何历史政权（金朝是12–13世纪的中国政权，与本作时代、地域均无关），也不应出现在政权归属字段中；「金」实为标题标注的材质（gold，金彩/泥金），应归入 material 字段，此处属抽取管线的字段错位，会让该展品的政权归属显示成一句无意义的话。
error_note_en: The metadata’s polity field is populated with “Jin”—for a 1633 Mughal Indian miniature, “Jin” corresponds to no historical polity (the Jin dynasty was a Chinese regime of the 12th–13th centuries and is unrelated to the work’s period and region) and should not appear in the polity field; “Jin” actually denotes the material specified in the title (gold, gold decoration or shell gold) and belongs in the material field, making this a field misalignment in the extraction pipeline that causes the object’s polity attribution to display as a meaningless statement.

missing.zh: 《波士顿宝座》长期存在真伪争议：学界对其究竟是古代真品，还是19世纪为配合罗马Ludovisi Throne而制作的现代仿古伪作存在过明确的正反论证（如学者曾提出伪作说，馆方与部分学者主张真品），现有资料未给出权威定论；若最终被认定为现代伪作，将从根本上取消其作为古代地中海雕塑代表作的资格，而不只是次要考证问题。
missing.en: The Boston Throne has long been subject to an authenticity dispute: scholarship has presented clear arguments for and against its being either an ancient original or a modern antiquarian forgery made in the 19th century to accompany the Roman Ludovisi Throne (for example, some scholars have proposed forgery, while the museum and some scholars maintain that it is genuine), and the available information provides no authoritative conclusion; if it is ultimately identified as a modern forgery, its qualification as a representative work of ancient Mediterranean sculpture would be fundamentally nullified, rather than this being merely a minor attribution issue.
